RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Respectable Flat form for the Crisfords and has made a bright start over hurdles, winning as he liked last time at Worcester (good); the second nearly went one better next time; a strong contender even with a penalty.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham
Spotlight: Won the Bunbury Cup in 2023; unraced beyond 1m on the Flat but seemed to stay the trip okay on jumps debut here following a long absence; however, what he achieved behind an easy winner in that small field is questionable.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished last in his two point bumpers when trained by Lily Bradstock; showed more on stable/bumper debut when beaten 12l at Market Rasen but there will probably be other days.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beat one home in a 1m AW maiden and was 300-1 when pulled up on hurdling debut (hooded).

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won her Irish Flat maiden (1m4f) on heavy but it was good ground for her two visits to Newton Abbot and she won by 10l three weeks ago; penalised accordingly but clearly going the right way and her form is up there.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 15-race maiden off the Flat with a basement handicap mark; no real appeal on hurdling debut.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 150-1 when tailed off in a bumper here only 17 days ago.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 1m3f/1m4f wins at a lowly level and it was a modest race in which she ran second on jumps debut at Cartmel (good; jumping lacked fluency); others preferred.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Tailed off in a bumper and pulled up in a recent maiden here after a long absence.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Placed in her last two Irish points so has ability and Harry Cobden is booked for her rules debut; still likely best watched over this trip.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Left Karl Burke for 7,000gns and as a seven-race maiden; beaten 49l and 24l in two runs over hurdles.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Ran okay in two bumpers but it's hard to rate her form too highly; best watched.

RaceName: Chloe Mediumship Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Early casualty on debut; didn't show a lot when beaten a long way here 17 days ago.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)
Spotlight: New Bay filly; closely related to winners Queen Me (Group-placed 6f 2yo; RPR 104) and Bint Queen Kindly (7f; 95), half-sister to two winners including Alia Choice (5f AW/5.4f turf; 97); dam 5f/6f winner (including 2yo Group 2; 112), out of 6f Group 2 winner; lots to like on paper and she's an interesting newcomer.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)
Spotlight: 140,000euros yearling; didn't live up to market expectations at Yarmouth (6f, good to soft) in May but she ran green before making some late headway; that debut form is modest but she should know more this time and it wouldn't be a surprise if she took a major step forward upped in trip.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)
Spotlight: 350,000gns yearling; sister to five winners including Expensive Queen (US 1m/8.5f inc Grade 1; RPR 116), Antonia De Vega (7f-1m4f including 2yo/Group 3; 112) and Al Haarith (1m; 96); dam Listed-placed 7f winner (100), half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Al Wukair; has a striking pedigree and she needs a close look on debut.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)
Spotlight: Has shown ability in a couple of small fields, most recently when runner-up behind an odds-on rival at Beverley (7.4f, good); has looked rather headstrong so far but it's still early days and she sets the standard on this drop back in trip; one of two runners for Karl Burke.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)
Spotlight: 110,000euros yearling by Blue Point; weak 15-2 shot at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) last month and she got outpaced before finishing a remote third of five; should be more streetwise this time but she needs a transformation upped in trip.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)
Spotlight: 40-1 at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) last week but she was always prominent and gave it a good shot before finishing a 3l fourth of 12; that was a promising start and has each-way claims if she can build on that.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Inc' Race)
Spotlight: 50-1 and she faded into a well-held fourth of five at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; that form is well below the standard here and she could be more of a handicap prospect.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Has modest strike-rate on the Flat and is 0-4 over hurdles; placed off today's mark on handicap hurdle debut at Southwell (2m, good) last month but subsequent run in Worcester maiden was underwhelming; others have more persuasive profiles.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
OwnerName: G C Myddelton & V E C Taylor
Spotlight: Not seen over hurdles since 65l defeat on handicap debut in April 2025 but pretty consistent over fences since; reverts to this code with trip/ground suitable; might be the answer.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Had jumping issues and struggled in Hexham chase on last month's stable debut; now 5lb lower than when placed over hurdles at Stratford (2m2f, good) on final start for Daisy Hitchins but still has something to prove.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Kept on for third of 13 in Hereford maiden (2m, good) in April but safely held when filling same position in two subsequent handicaps (both 2m, good) and needs improvement here.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Just held on to make all off 3lb lower at Warwick (2m, good) last May but, following a layoff, has dropped out quite tamely once headed here on both starts this season.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Front-runner who won three times (once over C&D) last spring; pulled up over fences at Worcester last month but her second there in May was a fairly good effort and she reverts to hurdling on a workable mark.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner for another stable last year; still unexposed over hurdles and wasn't given a hard time when fifth of 12 over C&D (good; beaten about 21l) on recent handicap debut, having almost lost his jockey when stumbling on the home turn.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Only sixth when favourite for handicap hurdle debut at Wetherby (2m, good to soft) in March and signed off for Jedd O'Keeffe with a poor Flat run in May but joined Dan Skelton for £21,000 soon afterwards and was quickly given a wind op; interesting to see what new trainer can do with him.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Weakened out of contention on handicap debut at Market Rasen (about 2m6f, good) 19 days ago but that was his first run since February and positives can be taken from it; not out of this if suited by the drop back in trip; cheekpieces removed after one use.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Managed a win off lowly mark at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) in October 2024 but absent since heavy defeat the following month (albeit on slower-than-ideal ground) and might need this outing.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Unplaced all seven hurdling starts but was prominent in the betting for all four handicaps and held third place before last-flight unseat over C&D (good) nine days ago; may yet have a bigger run in him.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 240,000euros yearling who overcame inexperience to score on her debut at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; likely capable of better despite the penalty; firm contender.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Blue Point filly who beat odds-on Godolphin runner by a head to win Yarmouth maiden (6f, good to firm) five weeks ago; open to progress and she's a player even with 7lb penalty.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 260,000gns yearling who didn't achieve a great deal when 9-2 and third of five at Goodwood (5f, good) five weeks ago; still very early days and that initial experience is unlikely to have been lost on her; step forward likely.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten about 5l in a turf novice (6f) and 7f maiden (AW) this month; a bit more is required and she might be one for nurseries.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Modest form in two starts and she'll be of more interest once handicapped.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 11-1 and apparent second string when she finished an eye-catching fourth of 11 to a stablemate at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; Speed Of Sound third) a fortnight ago; that was an encouraging first go and she commands plenty of respect with a fair chunk of improvement on the cards.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £70,000 yearling who was lively in the market when a close third of 11 at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; Sorrengail fourth) on her debut a fortnight ago; should improve and she's a leading candidate.

RaceName: Sports4Causes October Club EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 325,000gns yearling by man-of-the-moment Starspangledbanner; seventh foal; half-sister to winners Maria Branwell (5f 2yo including Listed; RPR 99), Lucky Queen (1m; 70) and Elegant Queen (Scandinavian 7f/8.6f); dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Samminder (6f/7f) and Queen's Pearl (6f); leading yard is yet to fire on the juvenile front but will no doubt click into gear soon enough; market check essential.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 80,000euros yearling; second foal out of a 5.7f-1m winner (including 2yo Group 3; RPR 106); 11-1 on Newbury debut in April but he led 1f out before keeping on well to beat a clear second; gelded since but that was a bright start and he's open to progress on this step up in trip; respected under a penalty.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 105,000euros yearling; by Sioux Nation out of unraced half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Emaraaty Ana; weak 14-1 shot at Carlisle (good to soft) last month but he finished a promising third from a wide draw; should know more this time and he's a likely improver upped in trip.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 50,000gns yearling; second foal; dam French 1m winner, sister to 1m4f winner Blowing Dixie, half-sister to winners Cursory Glance (7f 2yo Group 1) and Sweet Memories (1m4f Listed), out of 1m2f winning sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Time On; has good standard to aim at on debut and he could be a longer-term prospect.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 25-1 and he finished tailed off in a Salisbury maiden (7f, good to firm) for Martyn Meade last month; best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-brother to four winners including Raaeb (5f-7f including 2yo; RPR 108); disappointing when 6-4 at Ayr last time but the soft ground may have held him back and he showed plenty of promise on his York debut (fourth of 15) in May; just about sets the standard on that form and and he's a big player if he can bounce back.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 37,000euros yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 7f/1m AW 2yo winner Irrelevant (RPR 65); dam lightly raced maiden (66), closely related to 9.4f Group 3 winner Jack Naylor, out 1m2f Listed winner; yard 19% with 2yos this season and she needs checking in market on debut.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £28,000 yearling; sister to winners Scarlet Bear (Group-placed 6f; RPR 98), Elinor Dashwood (6f 2yo/7f; 92) and Spring (6f 2yo; 63); dam placed 7f AW (60), out of 6f 2yo/7f Group 3 winning half-sister to useful 7f-1m winner Bronze Prince; this looks a tough starting point and yard is 0-5 with 2yos this year.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has improved with each of her three runs but she was still beaten around 5l when fourth of eight at York (6f, good to firm; 50-1) last time; needs another major step forward here and others are preferred.

RaceName: Sky Bet For The Fans EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has struggled at big prices in her three runs (6f, good to soft/good), with best RPR of 26.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Lightly raced mare who took a step forward on her handicap debut with fourth of five at Fakenham (2m7f) in April; drops markedly back in trip here after a break.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Fair 1m4f Flat scorer who gained a first win in this sphere at Fakenham (2m) in January; faded from last flight when sixth of nine in 2m Worcester handicap on his return 23 days ago and should strip sharper here.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: A two-time 2m hurdles winner but ended last season on a low note; better signs on return with fourth of nine in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; needs considering.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Off eight months and much improved for his new yard with an easy first success in 2m handicap hurdle at Stratford last month; up 7lb but not taken lightly.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Resumed winning ways (in a change of headgear) in C&D handicap 17 days ago; he's not always proved the most reliable so needs to back it up now from a 5lb higher mark.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat winner; quite lightly raced in this sphere and he came in a well-held third of four in 2m3f handicap at Stratford last month; needs to take a step forward.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
OwnerName: Mr & Mrs R Newiss & Gavin Teversham
Spotlight: Gained a first hurdling success over C&D last May but his more recent form is far less encouraging, a well-held fifth in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; others appeal more.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Scored over C&D in May and has continued in good nick, fifth of ten over C&D 17 days ago; not out of things off a 2lb lower mark.

RaceName: Bridal Rooms Uttoxeter Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Modest ex-Irish 1m3f Flat winner; yet to offer much over hurdles and fences for current yard, behind when unseating rider at the seventh fence in 2m handicap chase here 17 days ago; much more is required back in this sphere.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Scored at Thirsk (7f, good) on his second start in May and, after finding trouble in the Windsor Castle here, he was just behind Silver Dominion when back to 7f and fifth in Newmarket Group 2 a fortnight ago; might not be much between them again and he's respected.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Eric Griffiths, Mrs T Burns & Partner
Spotlight: Belied market weakness and 40-1 odds when he made a winning debut at Bath (5.5f, firm) in April; highly tried subsequently, including when a not-disgraced fourth of five in Curragh Group 3 (6.5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; that form was a little dented on Saturday, though.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Came home well when he registered a winning introduction at Kempton (6f, AW) towards the end of last month; that form hasn't worked out yet but this extra furlong looks likely to suit on his turf debut.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: 22-1 and he did well to overcome evident inexperience to make a winning debut at Sandown (7f, good) six weeks ago; that race is yet to produce a subsequent winner but it's traditionally a good maiden and he's an interesting candidate for respected yard.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: The door opened on his third start when comfortably landing Leicester maiden last month and he defied a market drift to make a winning nursery debut at Chester (again 7f, good) a fortnight ago; this is a different test altogether but he's likely capable of better again.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Narrowly won on his debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) and he was far from discredited when fourth in a Group 2 at Newmarket (7f, good to firm; Alfred Wallace fifth) a fortnight ago; holds a future Group 1 entry and he just about sets the standard.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: 100,000euros breeze-up 2yo who was sent off favourite when showing a good attitude to land 6f Salisbury maiden (good) on his debut six weeks ago; shaped that day as though this extra furlong will be no issue and his yard has won this event with two of its last three representatives; likeable and has to be considered.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: He was beaten only 1l when third on his debut in May and made no mistake when scoring by 7l at Musselburgh (7f, good; favourite again) next time; 20-1 when he finished down the field in last month's Chesham over C&D but he has a Group 1 entry and it's way too soon to write him off.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: All three starts at 6f; he posted a promising debut at Nottingham in May and his midfield finish in the Coventry here, when drawn on the wrong side, was better than it looks on paper; stuck to his task well when landing a Salisbury novice (good to firm) at the end of last month, suggesting 7f is worth exploring; by no means out of this.

RaceName: Flexjet Pat Eddery Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Looked the business when taking six-runner Windsor novice (6f, good to firm) on her debut in May and was then runner-up to a good colt on softer ground 18 days later; had subsequent winners finish around her when 14th of 25 in the Albany last time and now tackles 7f; the sole filly but she can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt when making all for an emphatic win on nursery debut at Catterick (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces added) last week; this is a much deeper race but she was never in any danger last time and looks well treated under a penalty; key player.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Promising third on Ripon debut (6f, good) in May but she's been disappointing in both subsequent runs; still early days but she needs a transformation back up in trip on nursery debut.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in a Newcastle maiden (7f, AW) last month but that may have come too soon after his promising third over 6f at Ripon (good); looks interesting on that form and he's in the mix back in trip on nursery debut.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Good third on nursery debut at Catterick (5f, good to firm) 16 days ago but she finished 8l behind Lady Dublin over C&D (third of four) last week; has bit to prove again after that and she's now 0-5.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in his three runs so far, most recently when a 6l third in a Beverley maiden (5f, good to firm) three weeks ago; still unexposed and now goes handicapping but he needs improvement back up in trip.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has plenty of speed in his good pedigree but he's not progressed so far and was beaten 6l on nursery debut at Pontefract (6f, good) two weeks ago; still early days but he needs to significantly raise his game.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Nick Bradley Racing 13 & P J Makin
Spotlight: Has improved with each of her three runs and she went very close in a Musselburgh seller (7f, good) last month; now switches to a nursery but that was bold bid last time and she's respected on this drop back in trip.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't threatened in her four starts but she's only been beaten around 3l in last two runs (6f, good/AW) and her RPRs have been progressive; looks on fair mark now switched to a nursery and she should get a good tow into this race; dangerous.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Her form has been up and down so far but she won a Beverley claimer (5f, good to firm) in May and was a close fourth in a Catterick nursery two weeks ago; looks worth a try at this new trip and she's in the mix off same mark as last time.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Big prices and she finished ahead of just two rivals in three maiden/novice events at Chester (6f); still early days but slow starts have been an issue so far and she needs a transformation on nursery debut.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in three runs at 5f, with a best RPR of 40; half-sister to a 6f winner but she needs plenty of improvement upped in trip on handicap debut.

RaceName: Ruby Lodge Care Home In Thirsk Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Got closer to the target on nursery debut when third of eighth at Pontefract (6f, good) two weeks ago; rallied well in the closing stages of that race and she's a player if she can find some extra spark.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Lacked fluency and was well beaten when back under rules at Stratford (2m6f, good to firm) last month but has good strike-rate in points (10-22) and can't be ruled out off current handicap mark.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Returned from 12-week break with poor run last month and is now 0-7 over fences but was close second off this mark to a dual subsequent winner at Doncaster (3m2f, good to soft) in March; player if back on song.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Won maiden hurdle here (2m7f, good) in September but has lost her way since, and was tailed off on recent chasing debut; might be aided by the refitted tongue-tie but it takes a big leap of faith to support her.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: The Galloping Dentist At 45 The Green
Spotlight: Generally disappointing since last summer's 2m7f hurdle win for a different stable but took big step back in right direction and ran well for a long way when third over fences at Worcester (2m4f, good) last month; back up in trip here; a possible.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Dual Irish point winner; launched chasing career with two underwhelming runs this spring (3m/3m2f) and is now 0-5 under rules but can't be written off just yet.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Seemed to run well when second of three in tactical race at Cartmel (3m1f, good) on Monday and remains 2lb lower than when winning for another stable in January but others appeal more all the same.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Mostly out of form since joining current stable just over a year ago and was pulled up when upped to 2m7f for Bangor hurdle race last month, after a layoff; reverts to chasing in first-time visor; has too much to prove.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Ran quite well when second of four behind a next-time-out winner over C&D (good) last month and her subsequent run is best overlooked (pulled up; jockey presumably felt something was amiss) but she's too inconsistent to rely upon heavily.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Perhaps unlucky not to finish closer than third on stable debut at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good to soft) in April, having made a jumping error two out, but two lesser efforts have followed; first attempt at 3m under rules; needs to up his game.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: 0-16 over hurdles but ran big race in defeat over C&D (good) on chasing debut six weeks ago and has obvious claims if able to replicate that performance.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Bounced back to form to cause 14-1 surprise in four-runner chase at Huntingdon (2m7f, good to firm) in May and is still on a workable mark after 2lb nudge but it's hard to predict whether he'll be in the right mood again.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Came good under rules at 12th attempt with C&D success (good; clear second won next time out) in May but was pulled up when back here last month; had another wind op (his second) soon afterwards and is now tongue tied; not an easy one to predict.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Won two modest 3m2f chases in the autumn (good/good to soft) and returned from break with encouraging run at Cartmel (2m5f, good) in May but others in this line-up look a bit stronger; 1lb wrong.

RaceName: Craig Reid Retirement Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: 0-13 under all codes and absent since struggling in heavy-ground C&D contest in December (first-time cheekpieces); might be happier on this quicker surface but still makes only limited appeal from 5lb out of the weights.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressive sort who won four times last year and has kicked on again this term, landing a four-runner handicap at Lingfield (1m6f, good) in May and third of 20 under 5lb penalty in the Northumberland Plate (2m, AW; Kirchner second) four weeks ago; effectively on the same mark as last time; good chance.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who was upped to 2m on his third start for this yard when a fine second of 20 in the Northumberland Plate at Newcastle (2m, AW; Synergism third) four weeks ago; 2lb nudge could have been worse and he's unexposed over staying trips; big player.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Elb Bloodstock Ltd And R L Banks
Spotlight: Won the Shergar Cup Stayers handicap over C&D last August and he was back to that level when second over 1m6f here (good to firm) a fortnight ago; remains on a competitive mark and needs respect.

RaceName: John Guest Racing Brown Jack Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Career-best form this term includes a win on her reappearance at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) in April; handicapper might have her pegged now, so this new trip will need to unlock more; still not ruled out.

RaceName: Graham Lee Injured Jockeys' Fund Donate Today Handicap
Spotlight: Eight wins at up to 2m2f and he's versatile ground-wise; his last success was off 5lb higher at Catterick (1m4f) last autumn but he's been out of sorts this season and was tailed off at York last time; now drops back in grade but he needs a major revival.

RaceName: Graham Lee Injured Jockeys' Fund Donate Today Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive 4yo who made it 2-5 on turf when completing a double at Nottingham (1m6f, good) in May; 4lb higher after a short break but he remains feasibly treated and is still unexposed at staying trips; key player.

RaceName: Graham Lee Injured Jockeys' Fund Donate Today Handicap
Spotlight: 50-1 second in a Windsor maiden (11.4f, good) last May but he was tailed off in his final two runs (novice/handicap) last season; still unexposed but he's untried at this trip; non-runner when due to make his reappearance at Newbury (8.15) on Thursday.

RaceName: Graham Lee Injured Jockeys' Fund Donate Today Handicap
OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Xxiii & M Hulin
Spotlight: Won handicaps at Leicester (1m4f, good) and Redcar (1m6f, good to firm) in the spring but he's failed to beat a rival in last two starts; bit to prove but he got shuffled back in a tactical race at Chester last time and has possibilities if he can bounce back.

RaceName: Graham Lee Injured Jockeys' Fund Donate Today Handicap
Spotlight: Still a maiden after 12 starts and was last of four in a Doncaster handicap (14.5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; wasn't beaten far in that race but he needs to find more to get off the mark.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Low-mileage mare with 2-4 strike-rate for current stable, the latter win gained in first-time cheekpieces at Worcester (2m4f, good) last month; disappointed here on latest outing but could have untapped potential over this new trip if quickly back in the groove.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has some useful form on his CV but has become very disappointing this year, usually weakening quickly; had wind op before penultimate run but it didn't appear to make much difference; others look much safer.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Posted three respectable efforts at around 2m4f this spring and continues to edge down the weights, but he is not bred to benefit from this step up in trip and others in this field have more interesting profiles.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: In good form in the autumn, most notably when winning in first-time visor at Stratford (2m6f, good), but failed to build upon a satisfactory reappearance run when well beaten back at Stratford last month (wore cheekpieces); goes without headgear here; has a point to prove.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Battled well to hold on over C&D (good) last month and is now 5-10 since joining current stable just over a year ago; up another 5lb but a likely contender again.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual Irish point winner who built upon her promising rules debut when winning a Bangor maiden hurdle (2m3f, good) last month; has a lot more on her plate in this handicap but has obvious scope for further progress over the longer trip; commands respect.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Safely held in 2m4f chase here last month and now 0-9 under rules; back up in trip and fitted with tongue-tie for this return to hurdling; considered only if lively in the betting.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Just 1-12 over hurdles but ran quite well when third at Newton Abbot in May and was in contention for a place before last-flight error cooked his goose at Warwick (also 3m2f, good) last month; could have a say.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won this for Olly Murphy in 2024; returned from long absence with two lesser efforts towards end of last season but ran well for a long way when fifth in higher-grade C&D (good) contest for new stable this month; considered.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Gained both British wins at Bangor, latterly when making all (2m7f, good) four weeks ago; remains unexposed over this sort of trip and is probably still on a workable mark after recent 4lb rise; high on the list.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has worked her way back to peak form, following a break, and scored by just over 4l over C&D (good) six weeks ago; 5lb higher now but ought to make her presence felt again.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ended last season in career-best form, winning easily at Taunton (3m, good) before finishing third over same C&D off new mark; probably needs to find more again on this first run for three months, though.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: A C Bound & Mrs C J Djivanovic
Spotlight: In good form when last seen in autumn 2024 and will be suited by today's trip/ground but he is entitled to benefit from this outing.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Suggested her turn might be near again when second at Bangor (2m7f, good) in May but Cartmel last month was a backward step and she's now 0-6 for current stable; cheekpieces (worn once last year) tried again.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Regressive 9yo who has modest strike-rate in recent years and made a low-key reappearance this month (2m4f); tries a new trip here; not the percentage call.

RaceName: Eaton Hall Shooting Ground Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Came from off the pace to win C&D mares' race (good) nine days ago and is now 3-17 over hurdles; due only a 3lb rise for that and faces tough task under 7lb penalty instead, but at least we know she's in good nick.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Performed respectably in three starts over C&D for Roger Varian and he made a winning stable debut at Meydan (1m4f, good) in January; lesser show at Abu Dhabi followed and he once again raced freely when beaten 17l in the Duke Of Edinburgh over C&D at last month's Royal meeting; hood makes a reappearance, which can be viewed positively.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-Polish filly who was an unlucky second in Windsor handicap (1m2f, good to firm) on her stable/seasonal debut in May; near that form when fourth of nine in Pontefract Listed event (1m4f, good) one month ago; not hard to envisage another good effort.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 1m2f/11.5f novice winner who was purchased out of the Gosden stable for 58,000gns in the autumn; encouraging stable debut when second over 1m2f at Sandown three weeks ago, when he dropped some strong hints the step back up to this trip would see him in even better light; interesting.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: He was attempting to win a 1m2f Sandown handicap for the second successive year when fourth (Theory Of Tides second) three weeks ago; will need more on this second attempt at 1m4f (finished fifth on AW three years ago).

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Course winner over 1m6f (also has two wins at 1m4f) but he hasn't scored since August 2024; posted a couple of mighty seconds in big handicaps on AW and turf last term but he's yet to get going in two starts this year; dangerous mark if he can stage a revival and the market might be revealing.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: In the veteran stage now but his two runs at York this term prove he still retains ability, latterly when sticking on into midfield in valuable 10.5f event a fortnight ago; his sole start at 1m4f (in December 2024) returned his best RPR and this second attempt is well worth another go.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has improved for the fitting of blinkers and it was an excellent second of 19 in the King George V handicap over C&D last month; mark took a bit of a knock for that but the form has been working out and he might have an even bigger effort in him; much respected.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: A gelding operation saw him improve to win a pair of 1m3f handicaps in the spring, and following a blip he was back in form when third at Ripon (1m4f, good) on Saturday; that may suggest he's plateaued for now but he can't be readily dismissed.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Wide-margin maiden winner in October; proved a little underwhelming when third on his handicap debut/reappearance at Newmarket (again 1m2f; first-time cheekpieces) in May and disappointed over an extended 1m6f at Doncaster (again favourite) seven weeks ago; no headgear today, which may help, and maybe this trip will be his sweet spot but there are questions to answer.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Last-gasp winner on AW at Lingfield (7f) in February but she's struggled since and was last of six at Catterick two weeks ago; that took her turf record to 1-23 and she has plenty to prove back at this trip.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who returned after 207 days off with a dominant display in a Lingfield handicap (6f, AW) last Monday; 3lb well in under a penalty for that success and she's open to more progress on this switch to turf; strong contender.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Recorded her eighth turf win when scoring at Hamilton (5f, good to soft) last month but she's been well held in both subsequent runs; has bit to prove again and she's never won over this trip.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Wetherby maiden (5.5f, good) in June 2024 but she's been lightly raced since and has struggled in her last four runs; mark is tumbling but she needs a major revival on her second run after a year off; cheekpieces added.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been on good or slower ground but she's been knocking on the door in her last five runs including when runner-up on good to firm at Ayr last time; on unchanged mark and she should be in the thick of things again.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Reached the frame in three maidens at Newcastle in the spring and she started her handicap career with a close call over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; only 1lb higher here and this lightly raced filly is an interesting contender.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won this race last year and she scored over 5f here (good) last month; can be a bit up and down but she's finished a creditable third in last two runs, including at Catterick (6f, good to firm) on Wednesday; shortlisted.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) in February but she's not gone on from that and has been well held in her last four runs; continues to drop down the weights but she has plenty to prove back up in trip for another new yard.

RaceName: NRFC Leading Roof Excellence Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; runner-up at Redcar (6f, good) in June but she's been hard to predict so far and was beaten 16l on her stable debut at Ripon last week; comes with risks attached and others are more convincing.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Gained a first hurdling win on yard debut at Worcester (2m) last August; back in good form of late, third of six in 2m4f handicap there two weeks ago; not out of things.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: A three-time hurdles winner (around 2m) for Jamie Snowden but signed off for him with a below-par fifth in 2m6f Cartmel handicap 14 months ago; needs to hit the ground running for his new handler.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Posted a very good second in 2m7f Worcester handicap hurdle in June; well-held seventh retried over fences there since and it would be no surprise to see him bounce back reverting to this sphere in a change of headgear.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Made a winning start for current yard over fences at Southwell (2m4f) in November but only eighth back hurdling in 2m7f handicap here 17 days ago; visor and tongue-tie are retried now.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; thriving for Tristan Davidson and bids for a hat-trick following handicap wins at Hexham (2m7f) and Cartmel (2m6f) last month, getting up late each time; up another 5lb but this likeable sort is a player once more.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Six months off before a win at Bangor (2m4f) in May and still going well when she fell four out in another 2m4f handicap there four weeks ago; this course winner must enter calculations in refitted cheekpieces.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Mrs J M Plummer & M E Sowersby
Spotlight: Bagged a pair of 2m4f Hexham wins in the spring and comes here on the back of a good second of seven to Dream's Ka over C&D last month; enjoys a 2lb weights pull here, so very much one to consider.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Landed novices at Huntingdon and Kelso in spring 2024 for Patrick Neville but off since posting a solid sixth in 2m5f handicap at Market Rasen over two years ago; the market can guide on this comeback run for new yard.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Made a winning start for current yard over hurdles at Bangor (2m4f) last July; has failed to build on it though, coming in a remote fourth in 2m5f handicap chase at Market Rasen last month; has it to prove back in this sphere.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: On the up since sent handicapping and he gained a second success in his last three starts over C&D last month, edging out Gardener; up another 5lb but merits serious consideration.

RaceName: Louise Hall Hen Party Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Yet to get her head in front but she returned from six months off with a very good second of ten in 2m handicap here 17 days ago; she's proven over this longer trip and well in the mix nudged up 2lb.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Sandown 1m handicap winner for William Haggas (1m, good), well held in Curragh handicap last month (off 76) on latest; previous three runs over hurdles didn't offer that much, albeit carried out early on final occasion; may need more time to make his mark hurdling and has to concede weight all-round.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Some promise in Flat maidens last year but has been disappointing in handicaps this term; recent hurdles debut was a bit more encouraging when third (Pebble Island 4.5l away fourth) in 2m2f Sligo maiden, despite some novicey jumping; more likely needed.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: First foal; dam US 2m1f hurdle winner, half-sister to winners, notably talented chaser Allmankind; dropped away quickly two out on Navan hurdles debut in December on testing ground; much quicker conditions here.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 70-rated Flat maiden with Donnacha O'Brien last year; couple of underwhelming runs in maiden hurdles for current yard, latest after 7 months' absence at Downpatrick 10 days ago; may come on for that comeback run.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Saddex gelding is half-brother to Czech 7f winner Coolishaak; dam 7f winner (RPR 76), closely related to useful 1m-1m4f winner Havanna Belle; market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Soldier Of Fortune gelding; half-brother to 2m hurdle winner Harty Cup; dam bumper/2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to useful 2m1f/2m3f chase winner Sraid Padraig; market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Trevor Payne/One In A Million Syndicate
Spotlight: Now 0-11 over hurdles but twice placed in Bellewstown maidens, including early this month after forcing much of pace; has his chance in what appears a weak maiden.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Court Cave gelding was never sighted on last month's debut in Clonmel maiden; best watched for now.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Pick of three maiden runs when rallying fourth over 2m6f at Downpatrick, well held after racing handier at Limerick (2m4f) on latest; back in trip now.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Modest Flat maiden but has shown a bit more hurdling, notably staying on fourth in 2m1f Bellewstown novice early this month (good), raced handier at Sligo latest but didn't seem to get home when fourth (4.5l off third-placed Bobby Kirova) in 2m2f maiden; more needed.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up in his point-to-point and modest efforts in maiden hurdles at Killarney and Cork; hard to make a case for.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Order Of St George filly dropped away quickly at halfway on recent debut in Cork bumper; switches to hurdles.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Huge odds and ran accordingly in 3yo hurdles last autumn at Cork and Fairyhouse; best watched on return unless market speaks.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Rated 63 after three Flat runs for the Hartys; surpassed market expectations on hurdles debut when second to a long odds-on winner at Bellewstown, not quite at same level when fourth at Cork a fortnight ago on quicker ground; encouraging jockey booking (claimer-ridden both starts) and should go well off a light weight.

RaceName: Tote Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Closely related to bumper winner Miss Mini Bee; dam French 1m4f AQPS Flat and 2m1f chase/2m2f hurdle winner; ran okay in an academy hurdle on testing ground at Navan in December, market likely best guide on return.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Lady Cobham
Spotlight: Won twice last summer (1m/7f, good to firm) and it was an encouraging reappearance when third here (6f) in May; saw little daylight at Goodwood a fortnight later but he weakened when last of 11 at Doncaster (again 7f) seven weeks ago; hard to predict what he'll come up with this time.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: He recorded the last of his three victories back in August 2024 but his mark had reflected that when very good neck second of 17 over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; up 3lb but another good show can be expected.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: Dual AW winner for Andrew Balding, latterly last June, who hasn't truly threatened on his last four turf starts for this yard; cannot be completely dismissed from this declining mark, though.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-time winner in Ireland (7f/1m) who has yet to sparkle in two 6f starts for this yard, including when beaten 12l to finish last of eight at Windsor (good to firm) on Monday; this trip is more suitable so heed any market signals.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: He had been getting his act together this term and his penultimate fourth of ten at Newmarket (7f, good) last month suggested his turn was nearing; it didn't come in the Bunbury Cup a fortnight ago but that can be forgiven and he's not without interest back in calmer waters.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough when scrambling home in Catterick maiden in May and he broke his handicap duck with another neck success at Leicester (also 7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; up 4lb but he might be capable of better.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: Eight-time winner (7f/1m) at a lower level, including when he comfortably made all at Lingfield (7f, good) at the start of last month; 50-1 when he made no impact in this grade at Sandown three weeks ago, however.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins at this trip and he was down to his previous winning mark when popping up at 25-1 in 11-runner handicap over 1m at York (good to firm) a fortnight ago; that was a comfortable career best and he might need to better it back down to 7f from 6lb higher; still respected.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: All starts at 7f; showed ability in the last two of his three runs for Andrew Balding but was beaten 20l on his handicap/stable debut in May; subsequently rested and has been gelded in the interim; unexposed and he's worth a market check.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: Likes to get on with it and he registered the latest of his six wins when making all in five-runner Brighton handicap (7f, good to firm) last month; went off too quickly next time but his third at Chester was a solid effort two weeks ago; same mark and this is tougher, though.

RaceName: Chapel Down Handicap
Spotlight: 11-race maiden but he's normally reliable and has been placed on six occasions, including in two 7f Class 5 handicaps in May; bombed out on AW later that month and subsequently absent, while this is a notch above his usual hunting ground.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother to winners Last Crusader (6f 2yo/5f Listed; RPR 106), Cool Azul (6f; 85) and Game Breaker (6f inc 2yo; 82); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (98); Eur50,000 yearling is by a young sire who is doing well; respected yard so check the market.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Fifth of 10 in a Naas barrier trial and ran respectably in a strong 6f Curragh maiden on debut; should have improved from that and be more involved today.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Placed in three sprint maidens including over 6f at this track; took his form to a new level when a close third in a Naas Listed race over 5f last time; will be difficult to beat with a repeat of that effort.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; dam French 1m5f winner, half-sister to useful winners Show Me (1m1f-1m4f) and Honeymoon Cocktail (6.5f-1m4f), out of Listed-placed 5.5f/1m1f 2yo winner; Eur26,000 yearling is by a Phoenix Stakes winner and could run well on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Slight improvement from Naas debut to Navan next time but needs major progress to take this.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Started at 80/1 and beaten 11l on debut at Naas so has to find lots of improvement.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Beaten approx' 12l in 5f maidens at Dundalk and Naas so will have to find significant improvement; hood and tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promise on debut in a Curragh maiden but swerved and unseated rider early on next time; best watched for now.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; dam unplaced 7f (inc 2yo/AW; RPR 59), half-sister to French 1m2f/1m4f winner Motadarrek, out of useful 1m1f/1m2f winner; Eur8,000 yearling was a 10,000gns vendor buyback as a 2yo; yard is having a fine season so could run well on debut.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to Italian 6f winner Rumba Club, half-sister to winners La Discoteca (Listed-placed 5f/5.5f 2yo; RPR 86) and Tees Aggregates (5f inc 2yo; 78); dam unraced; Eur6,000 vendor buyback as a yearling; decent pedigree and could run well on debut.

RaceName: JW4X4 Northallerton Handicap
Spotlight: Won four times over hurdles between July and September last year, but he lost his way in that sphere and has struggled in three Flat runs this summer; now makes his Flat handicap debut but he needs a transformation back up in trip; cheekpieces reapplied.

RaceName: JW4X4 Northallerton Handicap
Spotlight: Just one win in his first 18 starts but he doubled his tally when coming from off the pace to score at Carlisle (1m3f, good to firm) two weeks ago; up 3lb but that was a brave win and he shaped as though this trip should be within range; respected.

RaceName: JW4X4 Northallerton Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears
Spotlight: Seven-time hurdle winner who is 1-11 on the Flat; faded back over hurdles at Newton Abbot three weeks ago but she was runner-up at Ripon (1m4f, good) last month, and that was a bold bid after wind surgery; has claims on that form and she's in the mix back in this sphere.

RaceName: JW4X4 Northallerton Handicap
Spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who made it 3-6 in 1m4f handicaps when justifying favouritism at Pontefract (1m4f, good) two weeks ago; up 4lb but that was a comfortable success and he's open to more progress at this trip; key player.

RaceName: JW4X4 Northallerton Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins have been on Tapeta and latest was 15 months ago; respectable third at Redcar (1m6f, good) and Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in his last two runs but this is a competitive race and others are more persuasive.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Dictated pace when scoring at Southwell (2m) in June but came in a well-held third of four off 9lb higher mark in 2m handicap chase at Newton Abbot three weeks ago; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: Both Sides Of The Sea Syndicate
Spotlight: A dual 2m chase winner at Perth last summer; off 11 months but not discredited with second of four in 2m handicap chase at Newton Abbot three weeks ago; considered off same mark.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Ended time with Paul Nicholls with 2m Hexham selling hurdles success in May; well held both runs for new yard back chasing, only fifth of seven at Stratford (2m1f) last month; others appeal more.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who comes here on the back of a good third of eight (Ice Jet runner-up) in 2m4f handicap chase here 17 days ago; not out of things in his bid for a maiden success.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Winless over hurdles but she made a successful chasing debut in 2m Worcester handicap 23 days ago; up 5lb but not taken lightly.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Vastly improved this summer (after wind surgery) and completed a quick hat-trick over hurdles at Worcester (2m4f) in May; shaped very well on his chasing debut with short-head second of eight in 2m4f handicap here 17 days ago; hiked up 11lb but can regain winning ways.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
OwnerName: The North West National Hunt Racing Club
Spotlight: Making a promising start in this sphere (close up) when he unseated rider two out in 2m1f Kelso handicap last September; failed to build on it twice subsequently but back in good form over hurdles of late, so not ruled out.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Back from six months off with success in 2m1f handicap chase at Stratford (2m1f) in May; only seventh of ten in 2m handicap hurdle here 17 days ago but no surprise to see him bounce back reverting to this sphere.

RaceName: Eleven Eleven Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier)
Spotlight: Ended a losing run for his new yard in 2m handicap chase at Hexham in June and backed it up with a solid third of seven at Cartmel (2m1f) 26 days ago; in the mix again.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Bumper winner at Thurles last October (good-to-yielding) and promising hurdles debut second (third has won since) at Ballinrobe in late May (good); dropped away disappointingly in first-time cheekpieces at Bellewstown early this month however; headgear now left off and could be the one to beat if reproducing Ballinrobe run.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed on debut in Naas bumper last year for Tom Mullins; decent placed efforts on first two hurdling attempts for current yard in C&D maidens in May; more needed to play a leading role but has to be on the shortlist.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: 150-1, tailed off when fell last on belated debut for Tom Dreaper in Fairyhouse maiden in January 2025; hooded here on yard debut and market should be informative.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: British point-to-point form nothing to shout about, nor his run in an Aintree bumper; tailed off last of 9 on yard/hurdles debut at Downpatrick 10 days ago; can only be watched.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers, only glimpses of form on the AW and pulled up after poor round of jumping on hurdles debut at Limerick in May for Eoin Griffin; yard debut.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Cost 55,000GBP as a 2yo; half-brother to four winners inc French hurdle winners Norathir and Louvetot; dam Listed-placed French 1m3f/1m4f winner; 40-1, dropped away soon after halfway on Roscommon debut early this month; probably best watched for now.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Never counted when last of 9 on debut in good-class Leopardstown bumper over Christmas; switches to hurdles on return.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: John Henry & William Bates & Paul Hillis
Spotlight: Brother to an Italian Grade 2 2m1f hurdle winner; ran okay in bumpers last year when with Ronald O'Leary; mildly encouraging hurdles debut for new yard at Downpatrick last month, good bit more likely needed here.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Blue Bresil half-brother to winners Celestial Park (2m4f hurdle) and Global Fortune (point); dam unraced sister to useful 2m5f-3m2f hurdler/chaser Warden Hill; point-to-point form doesn't amount to much but yard going well so worth a market check on rules debut.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Affinisea mare is second foal; dam unraced half-sister to point winner Elusive Classic; limited appeal on breeding, debutante likely best watched.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Weakened into midfield on debut in Thurles bumper in December and far too keen (also made respiratory noise) following month before pulled up in Clonmel maiden hurdle; has had a break since and reappears on much better ground but hard to fancy.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Big odds and soundly beaten in May, in Killarney bumper and pulled up in Limerick mares maiden hurdle; visor now fitted.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-sister to a 2m hurdle winner; dam unraced sister to bumper/useful hurdler winner Grangeclare Lark; had a foal in 2024, pulled up after always trailing on belated debut in recent Cork maiden hurdle.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed some improvement when upped in trip, notably staying on late to chase home a hot favourite at Tramore (2m6f, good); didn't seem to stay over slightly longer trip here a week ago when fourth in a stronger maiden than this; back in trip and major claims.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
OwnerName: Call It What You Like Syndicate
Spotlight: By Lulamba's sire, Nirvana Du Berlais; dam won over fences in France, half-sister to smart 2m-2m2f hurdle winner Rolling Star; big odds, never sighted on recent debut in Wexford bumper; improvement quite likely now switched to hurdles.

RaceName: Tom McCormack Memorial Cup Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-sister to eight winners inc Hang In There (smart 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Logical Song (useful 2m1f-3m4f hurdle/chase); dam French 2m1f hurdle winner; never sighted when well held on last month's debut at Downpatrick; may need more time.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Not at her best in a Class 3 at Windsor last month but that was 6f and this drop back in trip should help; wouldn't look to have much wiggle room off this mark though.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Progressive last season and she reappeared with a promising third at Kempton (6f) in April; not so good since but she is on a favourable mark again now and dropping back to 5f can help; contender.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Made all in a fillies' maiden at Sandown (5f, good) 12 months ago; not at her best in her two runs this year but she's slipped down the weights and Oisin Murphy is booked; stable won this with a 3yo in 2023; revival could be imminent.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: On the up since blinkers were added, following her 6f maiden win at Windsor with a 5f handicap win at Nottingham five weeks ago; that form looks solid enough and she could have more to offer; up 4lb but should make a bold bid for last year's winning stable.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Moulton Racing And Mrs A Jordan
Spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when fourth of seven at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) four weeks ago; this first crack at 5f needs to spark improvement.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: 2-2 as a 2yo, winning a 5f maiden at Yarmouth and defying a penalty in a Windsor novice ten days later; down the field in two handicaps this season; dropping down the weights but others look more solid.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Solid efforts to finish fourth in each of her last three starts (6f, good or faster), running to a similar level on each occasion; Billy Loughnane takes over in the saddle and cheekpieces are now given a go; she'll need a good pace back at 5f if she is to come out on top.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Solid fourth over 6f at Leicester three weeks ago was the latest in a series of good runs; whether she is ahead of her mark remains a moot point though.

RaceName: Sodexo Live! Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won her first two starts but she was a beaten favourite in this race last year (handicap debut) and has been beaten a further ten times since; inconsistent in 2026 and the change of headgear isn't enough to tempt.

RaceName: Close Brothers Asset Finance Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Has won on turf but boasts a far superior strike-rate on the AW and hasn't been that threatening on good to firm in his last two races.

RaceName: Close Brothers Asset Finance Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Hit the ground running for George Baker with 1m4f/1m3f wins on the AW and was close up at Epsom despite stumbling at the start; that was no backward step and he should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Close Brothers Asset Finance Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Eight wins divided between hurdling and the Flat; off the same mark as when narrowly beating Mrembo in this 12 months ago and returns off the same mark; penultimate run was on a par with that performance.

RaceName: Close Brothers Asset Finance Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Off since a quiet run on the AW in December and that was after 147 days away so current wellbeing is an issue; however, only 3lb higher than when making all at Salisbury last summer (1m2f, good to firm) so not handicapped out of it.

RaceName: Close Brothers Asset Finance Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced filly who kept on for fifth on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f; 50-1) and there could be more to come now she's sent further.

RaceName: Close Brothers Asset Finance Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Reliable mare who wasn't beaten far last time at Epsom when just behind Imperical Cult; has run well in the last three renewals of this race, beaten 2l or less; considered.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in a Kempton novice (6f, AW) 16 days ago, but had shown ability in two starts on turf last month including when chasing home a nice prospect on her debut over C&D (good to soft; third has won since); this may not take much winning on nursery debut and she's high on the list.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't figured in three starts over 6f/7f on turf/AW; bred to be better than he has shown and wouldn't be a big surprise to see improvement now switched to a nursery.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Showed some ability on last month's Nottingham debut (5f, good), but has gone backwards in two starts since including over C&D (good to soft); bred to be better than that and interesting to see how she fares in the market on nursery debut compared to stablemate Sovereign Beach.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Little to get excited about in her first three starts and failed to beat a rival at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last time; may improve for the switch to a nursery but will need to; hood removed after one use.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in all three starts, finishing behind three of today's rivals in the process; lots more needed now switched to a nursery.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Out of the frame in three novices on turf/AW, though there has been a glimmer of ability; not dismissed on nursery debut if the cheekpieces bring about some improvement.

RaceName: On The River Ball+Chain Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improved on previous efforts when third of five on nursery debut at Ffos Las (5f, good; carried 2lb overweight) ten days ago; shaped as though this extra furlong would suit, but the first-time tongue-tie she wore then is now missing.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Showed improved form to get off the mark in a Curragh maiden over this trip five days ago; has a habit of starting slowly but makes up for it by finishing well; faces a tougher task today giving away weight but is still a player.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Beat subsequent Listed winner Carry The Flag on debut in a Curragh maiden over this trip on soft; didn't progress at Naas next time before disappointing in the Norfolk Stakes; might be better on easier ground.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Was well beaten on debut when trained by Archie Watson but much better for this yard when landing a Bellewstown maiden over this trip; this demands more but could be capable of delivering it.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Solid on first two maiden runs over C&D (sft) and the Curragh (6f; gd); the winner of latter contest won the Railway Stakes last weekend; off the mark in a 6f York novice since but seems to have the speed for this trip too; big player.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Won a Curragh maiden over this trip in heavy ground on second start; posted a solid effort in a 6f Group 3 next time but has been below his best twice since; can be keen so the drop back in trip should be fine but needs his best.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
OwnerName: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell
Spotlight: Best effort in five starts when third in a Dundalk maiden over this trip; has to improve plenty on recent efforts even getting weight from most of her rivals.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Was just denied over C&D on debut (soft) but has been below that level twice since, albeit in Listed company last time; has to resume her progress.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Rated Race
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in two maidens over 6f and will have to find plenty of improvement.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: Some creditable efforts season including when fourth of ten over C&D (good) on his penultimate run; that form puts him in the picture but overall record is now 2-31 and his last win was in 2023.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: 0-8 on AW but she made it second-time lucky on turf when scoring by 6l at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last week; this is a deeper race but she hit a clear personal best last time and is a major player again under a penalty (due to be up 1lb in future).

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
OwnerName: D B & Mrs C Lamplough & Partner
Spotlight: Nine-time turf winner who is well treated on his win at Catterick last spring; has been up and down since but he's finished runner-up four times this year including at Catterick (5f, good to firm) on his penultimate run; could be dangerous in another switch of headgear.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: Well below form at Catterick last week but he had a near-miss over C&D (good) last month and he made all when winning this race last year; has claims if he can bounce back again and he's in the mix.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
OwnerName: Ursa Major & Mark Walford Racing Club
Spotlight: Showed some promise for George Scott last season but she's finished down the field in her three handicaps including on recent stable debut at Ripon (6f, good); may have needed that run but she's now 0-7 and others are more convincing.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: 12-race maiden who has form figures of 556097 in handicaps and was always in rear at Beverley (5f, good to firm) last Tuesday; opposable.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: 0-9 but she finished a respectable third off this reduced mark at Beverley (5f, good to firm) ten days ago; could go well again but she needs to find something extra to make the breakthrough.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: Third in a Catterick novice (5f, good to firm) in May but that form has taken several knocks and she's failed to get competitive in three handicaps since.

RaceName: Racing Excellence Apprentice Handicap (Apprentice Training Race - Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: Record of 2-40 on turf but his last win was at Thirsk last spring and he was runner-up at Beverley (5f, good to firm) last week; looks interesting off 1lb lower here and he's respected back at this track.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Enjoying good campaign for new yard, winning at Doncaster (7f, good) last month and short-headed there (7f, good to firm) latest; still mileage in his mark on old form (2yo Listed win here in 2022); didn't run well in 2023 when he wore blinkers (replacing cheekpieces) but lots to like otherwise.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: 1m 2yo Group 3 winner at Longchamp in September 2024; he's nothing like the same force now but has dropped down the weights and wasn't beaten far in seventh of 17 at Ayr (6f, good) last time despite a slow start; not ruled out back up to 7f.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: His wins have come on slow ground and he's unraced on a fast surface, but he kept on for a respectable sixth of 17 at Ayr (6f, good) last time and could have an each-way shout if the going isn't an issue.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer who has been running well in defeat over 6f this season, including here; his last win came over 7f at Musselburgh last April and he could be in the mix back up in trip.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Returned to form to exploit a reduced mark at Thirsk (7f, good) last month on his third start for this yard; a modest 3lb rise has followed and he's a contender if backing up that latest performance.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
OwnerName: Total Asbestos Solutions Ltd & A Frost
Spotlight: Sixth of 22 over C&D (good) in May on reappearance and further respectable efforts when fifth of 14 on his next two starts (7f, good to firm); however, he needs something extra to return to winning ways today.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Made it five wins from his last six starts when scoring at Wetherby (1m, good to firm) last month; only third of six when unpenalised at Beverley (7.4f, good) eight days later but not discounted given his previous form.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: 8yo who has displayed mixed form this season and was below par over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago, but he showed spark when third of 22 over C&D (good) two starts ago and he has an excellent record in this race, having won it in 2023 and dead-heated for first last year; respected.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Third at Pontefract (6f, good) last month and another good run when second at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) next time; however, soundly beaten here (6f, good to firm) latest and he's been unplaced on his eight visits to York.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: He's done well since this visor went on and he won a big-field C&D handicap (good) in May; merely midfield here four weeks ago but the blindfold was removed late and he was stretched by 1m; in calculations back at 7f.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who won two 7f novices last August/September; dropping down the weights and a market check is advised but he's been down the field at Doncaster on his three starts this season (7f, good to firm).

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: He's tackling a competitive handicap on this first run of the year and it's possible he'll be rusty; however, he was progressive for Stuart Williams during last season's 3yo campaign and is of interest on stable debut.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: 10yo who went close at Ripon (6f, good) in May and stumbled at the start when an unplaced favourite there last month; however, his last eight wins have come at Ripon or Newcastle and he's 0-8 at York.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: He's on a long losing run and can be inconsistent, but this front-runner was third of 22 over C&D (good) in May and wasn't beaten far when seventh of 20 over C&D (good) last time; each-way possibilities from low draw.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Ayr (7f, good to firm) in May and has continued in good form, beaten a short head when second of five at Hamilton (6f, good) a fortnight ago; back up in grade today but could give another good account.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Won at Carlisle (6f, good) last month before keeping on for third at Pontefract (6f, good) six days later, and back on the scoresheet at Carlisle (6f, good) three weeks ago; won over 7f last July; could be in the mix.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Fully 15lb lower than when winning at Lingfield (6f, AW) last December but this 9yo has regressed in recent months; has to turn things around.

RaceName: eventmasters.co.uk Handicap
Spotlight: Won two in a row in May (6f, good to firm/good) and finished close up on final two runs for Ben Haslam (6f, good to soft); changed hands for 14,000gns recently and he should be fine back up to 7f on his stable debut; might not be far away in a first-time visor.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Delivered on promise shown in Irish points when making all in a conditional/amateurs' bumper at Stratford (good to firm) last month; escapes a penalty for that and features prominently in calculations.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Hooded for both starts; bettered last November's low-key debut when fourth of 11 over C&D (good; against males) nine days ago and any further progress will give her each-way claims at least.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Soundly beaten on first two starts (both on good) and difficult to enthuse over.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal; dam fourth in a bumper and well held in novice hurdles, half-sister to high-class jumper Whisper and a French Listed hurdle winner; stable not that prolific in bumpers but this newcomer still looks interesting.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Failed to complete all three Irish points in spring 2025 but made the frame in two slow-ground bumpers for Ralph Beckett in early part of this year, despite racing too freely; subsequently changed hands for £12,000; major player if coping with this quicker surface on debut for Dan Skelton.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Closely related to useful 2m7f hurdle winner Doc Penfro; not beaten far when fifth of seven behind Thetype Istitle at Stratford (good to firm) last month but needs to build on that performance; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a hurdle-winning sister to smart bumper/jumps winner Super Duty and useful jumper Grandads Cottage; faded into seventh of 14 on debut at Worcester (good) six weeks ago and needs that run to have done her good.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Ebadiyan (Flat/smart hurdle), Ensaya (Listed-placed 1m4f) and Ebasani (useful 1m-1m4f); trainer doesn't run many in bumpers; well worth a glance in the betting.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a 7.5f Flat winner; kept on for fourth of seven (just over 5l behind Thetype Istitle) on last month's debut at Stratford but others have more pressing claims.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of sister to Listed Flat/smart jumps winner Noble Prince but well held when 33-1 for debut at Hereford (good) in April; hood removed.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a fair bumper/hurdle winner; no match for winner but kept on well for second of 14 on debut at Worcester (good; hooded, as today) six weeks ago; shortlisted.
