RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to a French/Spanish Flat winner; dam French 1m4f winner, half-sister to a Listed Flat winner and two useful hurdlers; trainer is not known for bumper winners but has booked James Bowen (3-10 for stable) for this newcomer.

RaceName: QuinnBet Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to a bumper winner; not beaten far when fifth of six at Newton Abbot (good) last month but it's not form to get that excited about.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Modest enough form in maidens; pulled up in first handicap at Downpatrick last time; new hood needs to transform.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Added a second hurdles win at Kilbeggan last summer (2m, good) off this mark; beaten 30l+ in all four runs this season (two over fences); drop into 0-100 category for the first time since his win is the one smidgen of hope.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough in some style at Punchestown in May (2m, good to yielding) off 86; respectable efforts over fences twice following that; disappointing reversion to hurdles at Roscommon (2m, good) last time when beaten 16l; capable of better.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Appears to have gotten the hang of things in his last two outings over 2m4f at Limerick; still in the fight when carried out at the second last in May (soft); confirmed that was no fluke when a 0.5l runner-up last time; if capable of reproducing that form away from Limerick then he has a big chance.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Won a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in August (2m, good to yielding) off 94; midfield finishes since then; well behind on the Flat at Naas last month; cheekpieces are added to the tongue tie.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Showed progression in handicap hurdles late last year, finishing the year off with a 2l second at Limerick off 87 (2m, heavy); Flat return at Roscommon was not encouraging but may do better back over hurdles, although may prefer softer; new headgear tried.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual hurdles winner for James Nash, the latest in April last year at Down Royal (2m4f, good) off 2lb higher; signed off with a moderate effort in a Clonmel claiming hurdle for his former stable in May; stable debut for new yard on Flat at Bellewstown was nothing to shout about either.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Beaten 20l on handicap debut at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding, 40-1) in May and his mark looks high for what he achieved in maiden hurdles.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Progressive Flat handicapper in 2024, winning three times on good/yielding; three maiden hurdle runs haven't revealed much but potential improver entering handicaps and worth a market check.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner has finished fifth in both starts for Gordon Elliott; just 6.25l behind the winner at Wexford (2m1f, good) but further back at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last time; probably best suited by softer.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Has a knack for finishing second (runner-up in four of last six starts); filled the second spot again on his return at Wexford in May (2m1f, good to yielding); just fourth at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last time when outpaced before keeping on; should be thereabouts again.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: AW winner in 2022, scored over hurdles at Down Royal in 2023 off 90; well beaten on the Flat when last seen in September; best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-27 and his run at Sligo last time was the first time he has ever placed when taking a 3l third (2m5f, good); 1lb rise seems a bit harsh; needs more.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Very ordinary form in maidens and no real improvement in handicaps; 11th of 13 in first-time cheekpieces at Wexford (2m1f, good) last time.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: 1-24 over hurdles with the victory coming on heavy ground at Clonmel in December (2m1f, heavy) off 2lb higher; beaten 34l over fences at Roscommon in June (2m6f, yielding to soft) and 23l over hurdles at Sligo last time (2m5f, good).

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Sole win from 45 starts came in a Tramore handicap hurdle off 3lb lower in August (2m1f, good); midfield finish over hurdles at Tramore in May, but tailed off on the Flat there last time.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Palace Pier filly who cost 110,000euros yearling and is half-sister to winners Fort Rock (7f 2yo; RPR 95), Nubuck (French 12.5f; 91) and Chuck Taylor (6f-1m1f; 69); dam a useful 1m winner; interesting debutante for a yard that had a successful newcomer last week.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 65,000gns foal by Showcasing; half-sister to winners Calafiori (5f-8.5f; RPR 79) and Mechayekh (1m); dam 6f winner and half-sister to winners Go Angellica (1m 2yo Listed) and Southern Belle (useful 5f/6f); doesn't have the best of draws, especialy for a newcomer.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: No match for the long odds-on winner at Wolverhampton (5f) where Elpeeare was a bigger eye-catcher in finishing hot on this one's heels.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs M V Magnier
Spotlight: Seventh of ten, beaten about 5l, over 6f at Yarmouth a month ago; raced prominently before weakening and may do better with the outing under her belt, now dropped to 5f.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: £110,000 yearling by Mehmas; first foal out of a 5f winner (Listed; RPR 101) and half-sister to winners Volterra (Group 3-placed 7f/1m) and Inishbeg (7f); market support could be significant when the yard's 2yos have been going great guns.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 95,000gns yearling; not a lot went right for her when a keeping-on third (just behind Delighfully Hot) at Wolverhampton (5f) so appeals as one who could leave that form behind; however, it could significant that Darragh Keenan rode that day but now partners her stablemate.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 400,000euros yearling; beaten 11l when made favourite at Beverley (5f) but her inexperience was evident from the outset and should be all the wiser this time; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Chasemore Farm EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: No Nay Never filly and the first foal out of a 6f winner (RPR 96) and sister to 6f winner Craved; the betting should offer clues as to expectations.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Sent off 33-1 but hinted at ability when beaten less than 4l into fifth of eight on last month's Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm); open to progress but it will be needed.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: March foal by Ubettabelieveit; 5,000gns yearling; dam 7f AW winner (RPR 63), closely related to 7f/1m winner Finbar's Lad, half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Pleaseletmewin, out of 7f winning half-sister to 1m4f Group 1 winner Rainbow Peak; wouldn't look an obvious winner on debut.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Has shown ability in his last two starts and did well to finish third of seven here (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago given his jockey rode most of the race with a broken rein; major contender.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
OwnerName: M Reddy, J Mallon, N J Clayton & Partner
Spotlight: March foal by Showcasing; brother to Italian 9.5f-11.5f winner Navajo Scout (including AW), half-brother to winners Ayr Harbour (7f/1m AW; RPR 105) and Desert Lion (1m-1m2f including AW/KSA; 104); dam 7f and 7.5f (Italian Listed) 2yo winner (103); already gelded and stable (also responsible for Napps Way) has few 2yos go in first time.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: No show in her first two starts, but not disgraced when fifth of nine at Windsor (6f, good to firm; 125-1) 11 days ago; nurseries are still likely to provide a better option, though.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Improved from last month's AW debut when second of five at Ffos Las (5f, soft) 13 days later; that form has worked out quite well and a player if she can repeat it back up a furlong on constrasting ground.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Not without support when beaten just over 2l into fifth of 11 on this month's Bath debut (5.7f, firm); shortlisted if coming on from that run.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: April foal by Perfect Power; 13,000gns yearling; dam placed 7f 2yo/1m3f (RPR 73), sister to winners Alhebayeb (6f 2yo Group 2), Azmaam (useful 7f 2yo/1m) and Silver Mission (6f-10.5f), half-sister to 5f Listed winner Humidor; stable not a noted source of winning 2yo newcomers.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Beaten a length into second of 12 on her second start over C&D in May (good to soft), but did too much early when fourth of ten at Lingfield (6f, AW) last month; one for the shortlist provided she settles better and copes with the quicker surface.

RaceName: Apex Transport Planning Summer Sunset EBF Restricted Maiden (Band D) (EBF Qual') (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: March foal by Twlight Son; 2,500gns yearling; dam unplaced 7f/1m (RPR 64), half-sister to 1m winner Mumtaaz, out of unraced half-sister to winners Izzi Top (1m2f Group 1), Jazzi Top (1m2f Group 2) and Emaraaty (smart 7f-8.5f); stable doesn't have many winning 2yo newcomers.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
OwnerName: Miss Kate McGivern & Thomas Hore & Shane M Power
Spotlight: His seven wins include this race in 2024; added a valuable handicap in Bahrain over the winter; bounced back to form after a break when winning a C&D Listed race last month but found Group 2 company too tough at the Curragh last weekend; this is easier despite his hefty weight.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
OwnerName: Mary B Hogan & Michael M O'Brien
Spotlight: Has been in career-best form this season, winning over C&D and at Down Royal before just failing to catch Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap at the Curragh; up another 5lb but can be a player; beaten 6l in Listed contest over 6f at Naas on Wednesday.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
Spotlight: Won this race in 2022 when trained by Paddy Twomey; only one win since but has run with credit several times this season, notably behind Kendall Roy over C&D last month; not as good behind Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
Spotlight: Won for the third time when taking a Navan handicap in May; a decent effort in a Naas conditions race two starts ago but was disappointing in a Dundalk handicap 12 days ago when reported coughing.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
OwnerName: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit
Spotlight: Maiden winner over 6f last year has mostly faced stakes company since and run well in defeat at times; drops to this trip for the first time with cheekpieces added; the drop in grade is a help.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
Spotlight: Second runner for yard; all four wins have come on AW but front-runner was second in this race last year off 2lb lower; just denied at Dundalk last time and 2lb lower on turf, so should go well.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
Spotlight: Won a C&D maiden last year and scored for the third time when taking a Bellewstown handicap recently; solid effort at Dundalk since off this mark but needs a bit more.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
OwnerName: Stonestreet Stables, LLC & AMO Racing Limited
Spotlight: Speedy filly won twice in Listed company last year; has found life tougher this term but some solid handicap efforts including at Royal Ascot; found Group 2 company too tough at the Curragh las weekend but has a shout here.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
Spotlight: Has been in the form of his life this season, winning the Rockingham handicap despite being 3lb out of the weights; ran a belter from the front in the Scurry handicap last weekend but didn't see out that longer trip; solid chance off the same mark if bouncing out of that race.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
Spotlight: Won a 6f Dundalk maiden in April and a C&D handicap in May on soft; just denied in a Curragh handicap next time but disappointing at York since; has a chance if rebounding.

RaceName: Doneraile Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Dundalk maiden over this trip last December and several good runs in defeat since including second to Sarahmae over C&D; needs more from 3lb out of the handicap and seems yard's second-string.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Tailed off here on final run last season and pulled up at Musselburgh on reappearance, but this lightly raced 4yo got back on track when third here (1m6f, good) four weeks ago and could build on that effort; chance.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: His sole win came back in June 2024 but he often runs well and was third of seven at Chester (2m, good) four weeks ago on his second stable start; might be in with an each-way shout.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Edging down the weights and the return to a more galloping track could help, but his claims aren't compelling based on what he's shown at Chester this year on his three starts for a new yard.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Carlisle (1m6f, good) last month and bounced back from lesser run there (1m3f, good to firm) when third over this C&D a fortnight ago (stablemate Furhaan second); might not be far away.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Lingfield (2m, good) in May on his second start of the season and has also scored with something to spare on both outings since (2m, AW/good); in a much deeper contest today but he's clearly on the up; player.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two wins at Newcastle (2m, AW) early this year and another at Carlisle (2m1f, good) three weeks ago; this 7yo is up 5lb to a career-high mark and everything dropped right last time, but he's nevertheless entitled to respect having won in fine style.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Ripon (2m, good) in April and at Catterick (2m, good to firm) last month; a case can be made on those performances but he hasn't been at the top of his game on his two runs since, including over C&D last time.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Behind a couple of these when fourth over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago but that was still a respectable run and she won at Carlisle (1m3f, good) prior to that; went close in this race in 2024; not ruled out.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Some good runs in defeat this spring at up to 2m1f and he bounced back from his Newbury flop to win at Chester (1m6f, good) a fortnight ago; he was given a good ride last time but could still be a force today up 4lb.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: He's gradually worked his way back into form for his new yard this year, finishing second over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago; one to consider.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Kept on for reasonable third of six at Doncaster last month on first crack at 1m4f before winning over 14.5f there a fortnight ago (good to firm each time); had just three rivals to beat last time but she's unexposed over staying trips and could be in the shake-up.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Some good form over hurdles, including a win at Hexham (2m, good) last month; shaped when fifth in this code at Hamilton (1m3f, good) in May as though he could do with a longer trip, and he gets it today; interesting.

RaceName: Elevator Company Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Arrives with something to prove having been well beaten here on her two starts this summer (1m2f/1m4f); however, she was progressive last July/September, winning at up to 2m, and she won over hurdles in March; possibilities if she's back on song in a first-time tongue-tie; watch the betting.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Handicap debutant; didn't show a whole lot in five maidens at 2m-2m6f on varying ground; others preferred.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Made the breakthrough at Sligo in May (2m2f, good) off 84; soundly beaten in two runs following that but her runner-up finish here last time (2m3f, good) is evidence that she could yet add to her victory.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo has been soundly beaten in four starts, including Clonmel handicap in April last time; visor goes on now but others preferred.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Fared better in second handicap start at Wexford (3m, good to yielding) in May following the application of cheekpieces when a 15l fourth; in the lead turning for home here last time over 3m1f before fading into fourth; drop in trip should suit and can go well.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
OwnerName: Gerard Mullins & Ms Mary Mullins & Ms Margaret Mullins
Spotlight: Okay run in opening academy hurdle last year when fifth behind the useful Quinta Do Lago at Cork (2m2f, good); heavy ground was a possible excuse at Punchestown next time; got loose before the start in maiden company at Downpatrick in May when tailed off; may do better now in handicaps.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Beaten +40l in both handicap starts, the latest of which came on seasonal return at Clonmel last month (2m7f, good); in good hands but hard to recommend on form.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 1-25 over hurdles, the win coming over 3m on heavy ground at Clonmel in 2023; is now 13lb lower and he showed promise at Clonmel in May when a 4.75l third of ten (2m4f, good to yielding); hasn't matched that performance in three runs since.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Dual Flat winner is 0-27 over hurdles; pulled up when last seen in this sphere at Sligo in May (found to be lame post-race); positive efforts on the Flat since, second at Tramore over 2m last time; strike-rate is off-putting but he has a place chance if bringing his best back over obstacles.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Three-time Flat winner is yet to score from six runs over hurdles; third at Punchestown (2m, good to yielding) in May was his best placing; okay efforts over fences and on the Flat since then; chance.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Unseated in both point-to-points; not much to go on in his three maidens, where he was well beaten; best watched unless the market speaks on his handicap bow.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Got to within 19l of the winner at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) last time, which was the closest he has gotten in five handicaps; weakened late on, so drop back in trip looks the right move but others make more appeal.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Tailed off in opening two maiden hurdles and would have been the same story at Sligo only for she ran out at the last; hard to fancy now entering handicaps.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-7 and yet to place; well beaten in both runs at Limerick this season, although on the second occasion she was sent off just 13-2; has never encountered ground better than yielding.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-11; pulled up on stable debut at Wexford in May but ran one of her best races at Clonmel last month (2m1f, good) when a 4l fifth; hampered on two separate occasions when fourth over further at Limerick last time (2m7f, good); this trip is on the short side for her, but she appears to have found some form.

RaceName: Massey Ferguson Johnston Farm Equipment Longford Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Well beaten in three runs this season, two of them in handicaps; hard to make a case for.

RaceName: Close Brothers Premium Finance Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Career win number 11 when coming clear at Goodwood (1m6f, soft) on his debut for Tony Carroll; effective on faster ground and a 6lb rise might not stop him if he's turned a corner.

RaceName: Close Brothers Premium Finance Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Hot To Trot 1 & Mrs R Pease
Spotlight: Ground this fast is a nagging concern but she's building up some momentum this season and was nailed late on over C&D 41 days ago; only had the 12 races and she's consistent.

RaceName: Close Brothers Premium Finance Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: In good form over hurdles and on the Flat earlier this year, last time going close in a 2m AW handicap off 1lb lower; if in the same form after his break then should be involved.

RaceName: Close Brothers Premium Finance Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Strike-rate of 7-50; won off this mark in March but well beaten in three of his four subsequent runs and has become hard to predict.

RaceName: Close Brothers Premium Finance Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Completed a top-of-the-ground hat-trick this year (1m6f-2m1f) and remains in good form, as a tactical race wouldn't have suited at Yarmouth and she was never ideally positioned after starting slowly last time (finished 8.5l behind the winner); another to consider.

RaceName: Close Brothers Premium Finance Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Dual turf winner at 1m2f and 1m3f for Charlie Johnston last spring; back to form in winning a 1m4f selling handicap on the AW earlier this month and was then second under a penalty; 3lb higher now but should be fine back on turf.

RaceName: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap
Spotlight: Has been flying since joining this yard (231211), her last two wins coming in this headgear combination with Mason Paetel aboard; races off a 5lb lower mark than when landing a Newmarket apprentice handicap (7f, good to firm) a week ago (9lb well in) and should take all the beating.

RaceName: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap
Spotlight: Placed several times over further in Ireland, but twice out of the frame since returning for this yard last month and is now 0-17; little appeal.

RaceName: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap
Spotlight: 12lb lower than when winning a three-runner affair over C&D (good to firm) for Alice Haynes just over a year ago, but hasn't been threatening to take advantage of her sliding mark including in three starts for this yard; look elsewhere.

RaceName: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap
Spotlight: Consistent in recent months, but was having his 25th outing when off the mark at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) ten days ago; 3lb wrong under his 5lb penalty and likely to find one or two too strong.

RaceName: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins on the AW, the latest at Lingfield (7f) in April; twice well held since despite just a 2lb rise and others make greater appeal.

RaceName: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap
Spotlight: Just 2-34, though both wins have come here since the start of last month; 2lb wrong under a 5lb penalty for his narrow C&D success (good to firm) eight days ago, though is just 4lb higher; each-way claims given his liking for the track.

RaceName: Cheeseburger Aaron Handicap
Spotlight: Doubled his winning tally when beating four rivals (including Too Much Trevor) over C&D (good to firm) 16 days ago; only 2lb higher and may be the one to capitalise if Prefer The Sister runs below form.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Far Above gelding; dam multiple 5f winner (inc AW; RPR 97), half-sister to useful 7f/1m winner Punch Your Weight, out of Group-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner Sun Slash; bred to be sharp; market can guide.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Half-brother to 7f Group 3 winner and two other winners; too keen when beaten 12.5 lengths into eighth on debut on AW 12 days ago; hood goes on down in trip; yard won this last year but he needs a big step forward to figure.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Well-bred 220,000euros yearling; very green when beaten 15l into fourth on debut 16 days ago; should know more now but needs plenty of improvement to threaten here; drops in trip for in-form stable.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
OwnerName: R Scahill, S Begley, J & C Bourke
Spotlight: Best maiden run when second at Cork in May over 7f on soft-heavy ground; solid run again when fourth on good at Fairyhouse; respectable runs in handicaps since but vulnerable in maiden company; drops in trip.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: No impact on sole run in 7f heavy ground maiden at Listowel 304 days ago.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Half-brother to yard's smart performer Indigo Five; looked like he'd improve for experience when seventh on debut at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago; likely one for longer-term.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
OwnerName: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan
Spotlight: Hasn't finished outside the first four in four maiden starts; improved again to go close at Navan (6f, gd) 13 days ago, beaten two noses into third, front three pulling nicely clear; improving sort who should be in the mix; cheekpieces go on.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: 9,500euros yearling by Profitable; half-brother to winners Goblet Of Fire (1m1f-2m Flat inc AW, RPR 96; 2m hurdle) and Across Earth (1m6f Flat, 85; 2m hurdle); dam 6f-8.6f maiden (64), sister to useful 7f 2yo winner Cherokee Trail; wears blinkers and tongue-tie on debut.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Palace Pier filly, half-sister to Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; shaped with lots of promise on debut at Sligo (6f, sft) when running out of road late on to reel in Baiana, beaten a neck having been poorly placed (dwelt at the start); greenness got her beat so she should improve a lot and is a leading player.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: 120,000euros 2yo breeze-up purchase by Havana Grey; dam 1m/1m2f winner (inc AW; RPR 82), half-sister to winners Tatsumaki (useful 6f/7f inc 2yo) and Ascot Adventure (5f-7f inc 2yo), out of 1m Listed winner; tongue-tie on; debuts for small yard.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Well-bred filly; promising debut when fourth in strong Naas maiden (three ahead have won since) over 1m on good; step backwards when beaten 7.5l into sixth as 5-4 favourite at Limerick over 7f 35 days ago (had winner behind her on debut); soft ground a possible excuse that day; definite player if reproducing debut run down in trip.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Improved plenty from low-key debut to be beaten 2.5l into third by Xerling in Cork maiden (5f, gd) 40 days ago; each-way claims if building on that back up in trip.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: 15,000euros yearling by Profitable; dam 5f/6f winner (RPR 94), half-sister to US Graded stakes-placed 1m1f winner Excelerina, out of Listed-placed 5f winner; yard can get maiden winners.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Fair runs in 6f maiden at the Curragh (soft) and at Navan over 5f (yielding), beaten 6l into third by Namiid; up in trip on quicker ground now.

RaceName: Navigation Road Maiden
Spotlight: Half-sister to four winners, inc Irish Territory (US 1m turf; RPR 105); dam Listed-placed 1m2f winner (91), half-sister to Ghaiyyath; promising debut when beaten a head by more experienced rival at the Curragh (7f, g-f) six days ago; drop in trip should be no problem and she can go close again.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 28,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to four winners including Plage De Havre (1m4f/12.5f; RPR 108), Batz (Group-placed 1m 2yo; 96) and Borjina (7f; 74); dam maiden half-sister to 1m 2yo Group 2 winner Rich Legacy; stable has low strike-rate with 2yos these days.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 100-1, slowly away and always in rear at Beverley (7.4f, good) last month; should do better in time.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 25-1 for his debut at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) last month but he made an encouraging start, finishing second of the 11 runners; improvement will be needed to win but it's certainly not out of the question.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Sent off at 33-1 when never in the hunt at Ayr (7f, good) 18 days ago; a big step forward is required.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: 5,000gns yearling; eighth foal; brother to 7f AW winner Pascalia (RPR 69), half-brother to winners Leodis Dream (prolific 5f including 2yo; 106) and Battle Point (5f AW; 68); dam 5f 2yo winner (73); one of two runners for the stable; likely best watched on debut.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Attracted a bit of support ahead of her Ripon debut (6f, good) 18 days ago but she got worked up in the stalls and never featured in the race; should do better at some point.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Three runs at 6f, showing her best form when third at Ripon 18 days ago; she was coming with a threatening run when getting squeezed out in the final 150 yards on that occasion and the performance can be upgraded; worth a crack at 7f; should go well.

RaceName: Ire-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish EBF Restricted Novice (Bands C-D) (EBF Qual) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
Spotlight: Brings the strongest form into the race having finished second of 13 in a fillies' maiden at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) five weeks ago; obvious chance of going one better.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Finally made the breakthrough in a Downpatrick maiden hurdle in June (2m3f, good) at the 35th attempt, having placed on numerous occasions; didn't bring that momentum to a beginners' chase at Wexford last time when pulled up after he made a bad mistake at the first and lost his action; overall record is off-putting.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: C&D winner off 2lb lower last year (yielding); form since then has not been anything to get excited about and she reverts to hurdles after two moderate chase efforts; cheekpieces go on now.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Mrs P Crampton & Oliver Crampton & DJCC Investments Limited
Spotlight: Put a line through his handicap debut in February when he was pulled up, having sweated before the off; ran his best race in a Bellewstown maiden hurdle in April when a 5.5l third (2m1f, yielding); didn't improve back there last time when weakened into fourth (2m1f, good); could go well on second handicap start.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a handicap chase at Kelso (2m4f, good) in April 2025, his first win since scoring over hurdles at Downpatrick (2m3f, good) in March 2022; heavy defeats in two runs over fences since return from a break so a revival is needed.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Lost his form after gaining a first win at Naas in April last year off 107 (2m3f, good to yielding); switch of stable brought some mild promise at Clonmel last time when shaping as though that first run back could bring him forward.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Slight ability in bumpers; won his third maiden hurdle over 2m here in June (good to yielding) despite racing keenly; tailed off in his first handicap at Limerick earlier this month (2m1f, good); a tongue tie is added to the previously worn hood; he's capable of more.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won at Limerick (2m3f, good) off 5lb higher last year; consistent sort has finished third in both runs for new yard; this is a higher grade compared to those outings but he's shortlisted.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: T Leopold, P Smith, D P Connolly & C Connolly
Spotlight: 0-13 and has failed to complete three of his last four runs; pulled up over C&D in April and unseated at the second at Clonmel last time; others more likely.

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Showed promise in the second of her maidens for Gavin Cromwell at Ballinrobe (2m2f, good) but well beaten in three subsequent outings; ran one of her best races on stable debut back from a break at Cork (2m4f, good) when keeping on steadily for fourth; not ruled out

RaceName: Tote Handicap Hurdle

RaceName: Sophie Busson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Losing run up to 16, but often placed and has finished runner-up in his last three starts off this mark, the latest a neck defeat at Beverley (5f, good to firm) on Monday; no reason why he shouldn't run his race again.

RaceName: Sophie Busson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Took advantage of a drop in the weights when making all to record his second C&D success in an apprentice handicap (good to firm) eight days ago, beating stable-companion Savannah Smiles by 2l; races off the same mark (6lb well in) and a big chance of following up.

RaceName: Sophie Busson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: 2lb lower than for the latest of three wins last year, but this season's form has been patchy and the suitability of ground faster than good is still to be established.

RaceName: Sophie Busson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Well handicapped on some of last season's form, but failed to beat a rival on stable debut after nine months off here (7f, good to firm) 16 days ago; others preferred.

RaceName: Sophie Busson Memorial Handicap
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who missed the whole of last year; not beaten far when last of four behind So Smart and Savannah Smiles over C&D (good to firm) eight days ago and 1lb better off with the pair, but he still needs to find a bit more.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: No impact in testing ground on first two starts but improved on yielding at Limerick (1m4f) 90 days ago when beaten 15l into fourth by Chablis Rock; ran in snatches in rear that day so needs to be sharper on handicap debut.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Looked well-treated when pulling clear with Adel on handicap debut over 1m4f (yielding) at Roscommon in May; below that on soft next time and faded into seventh at Naas 20 days ago; that race suited closers and he was up with a strong pace so he's not one to give up on; each-way chance.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Had shown little prior to second start in handicaps when beaten 4.25l into third at Down Royal (1m5f, gd) seven days ago; drop in trip doesn't seem ideal based on that but a player nonetheless; wears first-time cheekpieces; one of two for trainer.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Has been knocking on the door of late having placed for a third time running at Killarney (1m3f, gd) 11 days ago, beaten 3.25l into third by Chicago Moon; takes a while to get going so this extra furlong and cheekpieces could help; should be thereabouts.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Put in best effort in handicaps when beaten 4l into fourth (0.75l behind Point Cartwright) at Killarney 11 days ago, shaping well from the rear; extra trip a positive but needs a sound pace to aim at.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
OwnerName: N J Hitchins & Mrs John M Weld
Spotlight: Been improving steadily in handicaps the last three runs and relished the step up to 1m3f at Gowran Park 20 days ago when running the progressive Rodeo Blues to within half a length; had Point Cartwright half a length behind and meets that rival on same terms now.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't landed much of a blow in two handicaps; needs cheekpieces and stable switch to spark something.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Debut sixth at Gowran Park (7f, soft) not devoid of promise but soundly beaten since and never a factor over 1m at Killarney 10 days ago; up in trip.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Stayed on to good effect to finish fifth at Killarney over 1m and went like the best horse for a long way over 1m5f four days ago at Ballinrobe before being left behind by 50-1 shot; should go well dropped slightly in trip for in-form stable.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Couple of decent runs early on in a maiden and claimer; well-held in handicaps since; ran to form in claimer at Fairyhouse (1m2f, gd) when 6l second to Pass The Buck; needs improvement up in trip to defy mark.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Reversed form with Point Cartwright when 2.5l second to Chicago Moon at Killarney, sticking on well having set a good gallop; raised 2lb and should give a bold bid again.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Three-figure odds and ran like it three times in maidens; steps up in trip on handicap debut.

RaceName: Racing Again August 3rd Handicap
Spotlight: Not far off some of these rivals based on recent runs at Naas and Killarney; needs to find improvement from somewhere to reverse form; hopes pinned on extra furlong.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice as a 2yo, notably a Listed success at Ripon last August; life has been tougher since and hopes rest on the drop in class and addition of a tongue tie giving her a lift.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: Two modest turf runs either side of a cosy 6f AW win in January; still has time on his side but this opening mark doesn't look especially generous.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: Ran okay at Thirsk (5f, good) in May but that is sandwiched by two lesser efforts; others look more persuasive.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins as a 2yo, including here (5f, good), and he has run some solid races in defeat this year; latest fourth here (5f, good) came in a Class 2; one to take seriously upped a little in distance and dropping back down in class.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: This intermediate trip could suit but he was hit quite hard by the handicapper for his easy soft-ground win at Yarmouth in May and has been unplaced twice since; others look stronger.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: 6f win at Yarmouth in April and she has been placed on her last two runs, beaten just a nose at Thirsk on the first occasion; has the ability to be in the thick of it again.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: 5f novice winner as a 2yo; made a winning handicap debut with her front-running success at Pontefract last month and a subsequent defeat on soft ground (6f) is easy enough to excuse; still has untapped potential.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: Finished third in four of his five 2yo starts; bled from the nose when fifth of seven in a race won by Dragon Spin on his seasonal return last month; not obviously ahead of his mark.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: 0-8 but he has been banging at the door this year, placed four times between April and June; not at his best here (6f, good) four weeks ago but it was still a fair run and dropping back in trip won't hurt.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: Twice a winner in 5f handicaps this year, latterly at Thirsk last month; creditable fourth in a Class 4 at Doncaster last time but she will need another career best to come out on top.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: Just one win (6f, good) to his name from 14 attempts and that came at a lower level; others bring greater potential this time.

RaceName: Sky Bet Go-Racing-In-Yorkshire Summer Festival Handicap
Spotlight: 0-7 but she arrives having finished second in handicaps at Newcastle (5f, AW) and Nottingham (6f, good to firm) on her last two starts; up in class today and could prove vulnerable for win purposes again.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Better hurdler than chaser, though last win came in 2023; 0-9 chasing, standout run when second in 2m5f Down Royal handicap in January off 97; none too fluent and met trouble in running on yard debut here in May; best form is on softer ground; drops in grade.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden under all disciplines, best hurdles form when second in 2m5f Punchestown maiden; sole chase effort came on penultimate when never sighted in Limerick handicap in March on soft; inadequate trip back hurdling last time; high enough mark still.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Hurdle winner over three years ago; 0-10 chasing, good C&D effort last summer, not so good of late, 3m probably too far on latest; can't rule out back at a more suitable trip.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole win came for Adrian Murray in 2m3f Downpatrick handicap hurdle a year ago (good), couple of decent runs afterwards in beginners chases; two comeback runs over hurdles should have her straight and not one to rule out.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Last year's win (good-to-yielding) in this came off 87 and later scored over hurdles at Limerick on heavy; twice runner-up in handicap chases last winter on heavy, below best of late on better ground; ground concerns again here.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Chase win came in 2m6f Tramore handicap last year, more recently has been hurdling, notably 3m1f handicap win here; held off 5lb higher in similar contest a fortnight ago but interesting back chasing here off 3lb lower mark.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Maiden's best effort last year when runner-up in 2m2f handicap hurdle here; absent until pulled up halfway after never counting in 2m5f Bellewstown handicap hurdle early this month; only second attempt over fences now.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Quite lightly raced mare is 0-8 hurdling, safely held of late in handicaps; half-sister won over fences so could improve for this switch to chasing.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: On a long losing run and needs to improve markedly on recent efforts but is on a vastly reduced mark.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole hurdles win came in 2m5f Wexford handicap last summer, pick of six attempts chasing when second in 3m Downpatrick handicap in May (good); tame Wexford effort early this month but has to be respected on overall profile (cheekpieces worn recently now ditched).

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Sole win came in 2m3f handicap hurdle here two years ago; 0-5 chasing, most recent Wexford handicap fifth only mildly encouraging.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Front-runner a better hurdler than chaser, and her last four runs over fences do nothing to dispute that, pulled up here a week ago, having been headed some way out.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Two hurdles wins came some time ago; 0-7 chasing, most recently back from point-to-points when pulled up in Cork hunters chase in April; hard to make a case for.

RaceName: Racing Again On 8th August Handicap Chase
Spotlight: Heavily-raced mare belatedly opened her account in 3m1f handicap hurdle here early this month (good); week later ran well off lower chase mark when third at Killarney (2m7f); not sure if this drop in trip will suit but each-way claims off handy mark again.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Losing run up to 14, but now 22lb below his last winning mark and showed a bit more when fourth of nine at Nottingham (1m2f, good to firm) last time; that form is working out quite well and one to be interested in.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't run badly when fourth of nine in an apprentice handicap at Newbury (1m3f, good to firm) on his penultimate start, but is just 1-26 and most of his best form has come on the AW.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in his first three starts, but was only beaten a neck and a nose into third of eight on handicap debut here (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago (fourth has won since); should stay this far and this unexposed sort is high on the list.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: 3-27 on the AW and 1-22 on turf; 18lb below last winning mark, but offered little encouragement when beating one home over C&D (good to soft) last month.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: In good form on the AW lately, getting off the mark at the seventh attempt at Wolverhampton (8.6f) this month; 4lb rise is fair enough, but she ran poorly in her only start on turf at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) in May which does leave her with questions to answer.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Knows more about this game than most with this being her 80th start, but she hasn't been running like a winner waiting to happen and hasn't scored on turf since September 2023.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't shown much under either code and refused to race at Ffos Las ten days ago; easily overlooked.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: Out of the frame in all seven starts and cheekpieces have made no difference; look elsewhere.

RaceName: Weir Mechanical Solutions Handicap
Spotlight: First and second in two nurseries at Bath (1m, soft) last October, but not much otherwise and finished tailed off on her reappearance over that C&D (good) last month; best watched for now.
